rows.en: Ai: "What's that? It looks like some giant insect boss..."
Ymir: "That's... I feel like I've seen it somewhere..."
do creatures like that live there?"
Clovis: "For now, as a gesture of friendship,
should we give it some food?"
Touya: "I don't think we can be friends."
Clovis: "Touya, you take command of this battle."
Ai: "Hey! If it were me, sure,
Arthur: "Now, now. I agree with Clovis.
You're already operating Zeifon without any trouble,
and you seem to have that sort of talent."
Clovis: "You've got a spark of tactical sense.
Luckily, that's our opponent this time. It'll make a good practice target."
Ai: "Reeeally? Well, this isn't the time to argue...
Touya! You give it a try."
Touya: "Huh? You can't just spring that on me..."
But if I'm doing it, you follow my orders properly. No objections."
Ai: "Don't do a lousy job commanding us."
Fain: "...But! I'm not the sort of man
who'd be finished by this! Uoooooh!!"
Touya: "What's with that carefree, booming laugh?"
????: "The people call! The times call! They call me to vanquish evil!
Here stands the envoy of justice, Fain Jin Barion!!"
Fain: "Now that I'm here, there's nothing to worry about!"
Touya: "Is he trying to kill himself?!"
Clovis: "Can Mireon pull off a stunt like that?"
Arthur: "I'm sure it's only because it's him."
Fain: "Heh! Looks like something with a bit of fight in it
Mechanic F: "Central control unit adjustment complete!"
Celica: "Twenty-five jiki, six seconds, to spare! Pass!"
Mechanic F: "We did it! Here, a towel."
Mechanic B: "Hey, you there. Why are you relaxing?"
Mechanic A: "All right! Liebhofen is heading out!"
Celica: "Everyone inside! It's our job from here!"
Gabon: "Engine output check. Numbers one, two, three and four,
Boost pressure normal. Servo motor operation check."
Retract landing gear. Acting Captain, set our course."
Celica: "You're not the one who gets to say that!
I was just getting into it, too... A-Ahem!
Touya: "Whoa! Wh-What is that?! A battleship?!"
Celica: "Everyone, get out of the way!"
